telemetry.reason: The embedded Step 8.5 contract declares no gameplay telemetry assertion. The headless editor runner owns exact graph/transform/patch/budget values, screenshots own the live VOX/editor surface, and the incremental log owns runtime health.

setup.coordinate_contract: right-handed Y-up meters; +X right, +Y up, -Z forward; parent-local storage

reload.root_xml_discovery: The new root XML appeared in Level Editor File/Open without restarting Teardown. Selecting it changed Scene Explorer identity and Shapes count from 0 to 1, proving the XML and real VOX were reread.
reload.lua_reload: F4 returned to Level Editor; F5 reloaded the controller and displayed anchor-turret-editor-lua-v1.
reload.loading_recovery: Four near-black loading captures were rejected; the agent waited and only resumed control after a non-constant live editor frame.

actions: F5 reloads the selected root XML
Space moves it +0.20 m in parent-local X
M mirrors it across parent-local X
Home creates turret.live with base/yaw/pitch axes
End switches local to world transform view
Arrow Up selects visual mode and its 0/0/0 budget
Enter validates the graph and Runtime budget limits
Delete attempts a duplicate wing.muzzle.left and is rejected before a source patch
Enter proves the source remains valid after the rejected edit
F4 returns to Level Editor; emergency release clears all input

assertions.axes: Red +X/right, green +Y/up and blue -Z/forward axes are visible from the live Shape center.
assertions.initial_editor: The live surface reports 4 anchors, 2 mounts, 1 turret, 7 arc samples and logical budget 1/1/0.
assertions.edited_editor: Real input produces 5 anchors, 3 mounts, 2 turrets, world view, visual budget 0/0/0 and 17 source patches.
assertions.validation: Enter reports SOURCE PATCH VALIDATED / BUILD READY with graph valid and budgets <= Runtime limits.
assertions.invalid_gate: Duplicate ID reports BUILD BLOCKED BEFORE SOURCE PATCH, duplicate-id, rejects=1, and patch count stays 17.
assertions.generated_boundary: Every accepted state reports generated mutation=false; rejected duplicate appends no patch.

attributed_external_noise.details: One live reload emitted two missing TABS sound-bank errors and two groups of three TABS ballistics pre-init deprecated API warnings; every line points outside Content Mod 2.

log.post_action_tail: Anchor/Mount/Turret edits, view/mode switching, validation, rejection and cleanup added no CM2 error or warning.

defect_loop.failure: The adapter accepted an invalid graph during init, Turret definitions without a base Anchor, budget overflows, and rollback restored only a public snapshot rather than the full internal state.
defect_loop.fix: Made init graph validation fail closed, required Turret base Anchors, checked Body/Shape/Joint costs against limits, updated patch metrics, guarded all mutators, and preserved the complete rollback state.
defect_loop.regression: The 12-case self-test, Lua/API/XML checks and live validation all pass; duplicate input is blocked without changing patch count.

defect_loop.failure: The initial T key collided with Global Mod Ship Designer and opened an unrelated UI; the first Harness attempts also used non-canonical key aliases uparrow and return.
defect_loop.fix: Moved Turret creation and view switching to Home/End, retained Teardown's uparrow/downarrow names in the script, and used Harness canonical up/down and enter names.
defect_loop.regression: The final fresh-frame run executed all editor actions without opening Ship Designer or losing focus.

defect_loop.failure: F5 produces a bounded near-black loading interval before the live scene is ready.
defect_loop.fix: Rejected black captures, waited, re-observed, and performed no edit until a valid scene frame existed.
defect_loop.regression: Every accepted action used the immediately preceding non-black frame_id and exact target_id.

human_review_remaining: Subjective visual polish and creator ergonomics only. Objective VOX visibility/orientation/scale, marker and arc visibility, exact counts, transform views, real-input editing, budget display, invalid gating, catalog isolation, logs and cleanup passed.
